prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 公司差旅报销标准 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 6 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "费用项目" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 92px
  col 2: header "普通员工" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 170px
  col 3: header "经理" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 223px
  col 4: header "总监" · longest unbreakable word 35px · one-line width 202px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 480px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 479px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"Define travel-reimbursement limits by expense item and employee grade, so readers can look up their entitlement and compare grades.","reading":"Row-first: identify the expense item in column 1, then scan right across the three grade columns. Column scanning is secondary, for comparing one grade's package. Rows must read as units, and the grade columns must stay directly comparable.","groups":["Columns 2–4 are one peer group: 普通员工, 经理 and 总监 are parallel entitlement levels, so they need comparable widths and alignment.","Column 1 is the row-header key; it should remain visually distinct and readable but not dominate the table."],"keep_intact":["Amount+unit pairs such as 500 元/晚, 350 元/晚, 80 元/日限额 and 120 元/日限额","Fare/class terms 二等座, 一等座 and 经济舱","The number–unit pair 7 天 in 提前 7 天预订","Row labels 一线城市住宿, 其他城市住宿, 高铁, 飞机 and 市内交通"],"may_wrap":["Qualifiers 含早餐, 省会城市可上浮, 需提前 7 天预订 and 可改签一次","The comma-separated second clause in each cell","Longer row labels only in label-compressed designs"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r1A: widths [113, 116, 125, 125] · table 480×381px · row heights [36, 60, 83, 83, 60, 60] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 3 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1B: widths [113, 112, 127, 127] · table 480×405px · row heights [36, 60, 83, 83, 83, 60] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 3 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1C: widths [108, 116, 126, 129] · table 480×358px · row heights [36, 60, 83, 60, 60, 60] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 3 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r1A","good":"两个住宿项目的行标签保持完整；三个人员等级的列宽接近，便于沿行比较。表头均保持单行。","problems":"高铁行被拉高到三行，前两级只有简短的席别，留下较多空白；经理列的住宿说明也较零碎。","cause":"总监列为125px，“商务座，仅限单程 4 小时以上”需要三行；经理列同为125px，“省会城市可上浮10%”也需跨多行。"},{"design":"r1B","good":"行标签完整，经理和总监列略宽；表头保持单行，各等级仍容易横向比较。","problems":"飞机行比r1A更高，普通员工的预订说明被拆得零碎；高铁行仍有较多空白，整体纵向节奏偏松。","cause":"普通员工列缩至112px，使“需提前 7 天预订”占用更多行；总监列虽增至127px，仍不足以让高铁说明缩至两行。"},{"design":"r1C","good":"总监列加宽后，高铁说明缩为两行，飞机行也较紧凑；各等级表头仍保持单行。","problems":"两个住宿行标签都折成两行，削弱了作为行查找入口的完整性；经理列的住宿说明仍分成三行。","cause":"行标题列缩至108px，文字可用宽度不足以容纳完整住宿标签；经理列126px仍不足以减少该说明的行数。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"restore-labels","widths":[113,116,120,130],"change":"以r1C为基础，将行标题列恢复到113px以保持住宿标签完整，同时保留总监列的较大宽度；压缩经理列，检验能否兼顾高铁行和整体行高。"},{"name":"balanced-grades","widths":[113,116,122,128],"change":"保持完整行标签和普通员工列宽，在经理与总监之间较均衡地分配余量，检验128px的总监列是否足以维持紧凑的高铁行。"},{"name":"booking-room","widths":[113,118,119,129],"change":"给普通员工的预订说明多留空间，并保留较宽的总监列；检验经理列收窄后的换行代价，以比较两处较长说明对行高的影响。"}]}
